# nanoGPT provenance

Source: https://github.com/karpathy/nanoGPT

Commit: `3adf61e154c3fe3fca428ad6bc3818b27a3b8291`

`model.py` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged. The model is MIT licensed; the enclosing M³ project uses the MIT license. Upstream marked nanoGPT deprecated in November 2025. It remains an intentionally pinned research baseline here, not a dependency tracking upstream master. M³ uses its GPT and GPTConfig directly; the trainer is an M³ implementation. No pretrained GPT-2 weights are loaded.
